page_description: Bring unread Miniflux articles to your Kobo and keep reading without Wi-Fi. Digest is an unofficial client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Miniflux project.
release_notes: Suggested feeds returns to the screen it was opened from. Leaving settings keeps your place in the article list, with one consistent Back control.

steps.text: Have an HTTPS Miniflux instance, self-hosted or hosted, and create an API token in its settings.
Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Install the token under the name miniflux, then add the address in the app.
